title: When each arena lease ends, and what leaving costs

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Current lease ends after 2028-29 season; $550M renovation/new lease still unsigned as of Oct 16 2026 (the Oct 8 2026 Sports Authority agenda lists a construction agreement and a funding-agreement amendment; press reports approval)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: (Attendance clause/2022 settlement already known - excluded)
rows.summary: Ends after the 2028-29 season; a new lease is under negotiation.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: (Attendance clause/2022 settlement already known - excluded)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Initial term to June 30, 2029 (amended June 13, 2023); State agreement "set to expire in FY 2029"
rows.outs_penalties_notes: State must keep paying $3.65M/yr Quality Jobs equivalent through FY2029
rows.summary: The initial term ends June 30, 2029.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: State must keep paying $3.65M/yr Quality Jobs equivalent through FY2029

rows.owner: City of Portland (public since 2024: building bought for $1, land under it for $7.13M)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Operating lease expires Oct 11 2030 unless extended (Resolution 37750 recital); the 2024 bridge agreement has a five-year option to extend through 2035 (City Ordinance 191857, per ACFR FY2024, b); new 20-yr lease + $573M public renovation under negotiation, definitive documents due by Dec 31 2026 (Resolution 37750)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: City agreed not to enforce "first-class" maintenance duty during bridge (tolled); relocation needs City consent during term; team must repay City Contribution if it leaves; city ownership reduces property taxes collected by an estimated $1.2M a year (ACFR FY2024, b)
rows.summary: Expires Oct. 11, 2030, unless extended; a 20-year lease is being negotiated.
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: City agreed not to enforce "first-class" maintenance duty during bridge (tolled); relocation needs City consent during term; team must repay City Contribution if it leaves; city ownership reduces property taxes collected by an estimated $1.2M a year (ACFR FY2024, b)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Mavericks' lease at American Airlines Center expires in 2031
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Mavericks pursuing a new arena on the former Valley View Mall site (June 2026)
rows.summary: Ends in 2031; the team plans a new arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Mavericks pursuing a new arena on the former Valley View Mall site (June 2026)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: The 76ers plan to leave the arena when their lease expires in 2031 (Front Office Sports, c) and move to a new private South Philadelphia arena with Comcast Spectacor (target 2030-31)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.summary: The lease runs to 2031; the team plans to move to a privately funded arena in 2030.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease of the Frost Bank (AT&T) Center ends in 2032 (KSAT 2023); downtown arena targeted to open for the 2032-33 season (TPR 2025)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Break fees of up to $124M, depending on the year (KSAT 2023)
rows.summary: Ends in 2032; breaking it costs up to $124M, depending on the year.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Break fees of up to $124M, depending on the year (KSAT 2023)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Term = 360 months from Oct-2003 commencement (ends after 2032-33); no extension reported with Apr-2026 $180M renovation ($95M State of Texas)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Landlord duty to renovate to "first-class, state of the art" standard (s8.6) limited to Renovation Fund
rows.summary: Runs through the 2032-33 season; no extension reported.
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Landlord duty to renovate to "first-class, state of the art" standard (s8.6) limited to Renovation Fund

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Through 2033-34 season + two successive 5-yr TEAM options
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Gateway owes Major Capital Repairs; told City/County it lacks funds
rows.summary: Runs through the 2033-34 season, with two five-year team options.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Gateway owes Major Capital Repairs; told City/County it lacks funds

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Play through 2034-35 season (2016 agreement)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: $50M payment to city if not fulfilled; $53.5M city debt service 2026-35
rows.summary: The team must play there through the 2034-35 season or pay the city $50M.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: $50M payment to city if not fulfilled; $53.5M city debt service 2026-35

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Use Agreement ends June 30 2035 (2024 interlocal funding agreement, b); before the county issues its Contract Sixth Cent bonds (2027 at the earliest) the city must negotiate an extension at least as long as those bonds, with non-relocation penalties covering the remaining debt; the 2016 interlocal (s.5.4.7) also gives a five-year renewal option
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Rent $1M/contract year
rows.summary: Runs to 2035; no extension reported.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Rent $1M/contract year

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease through 2035-36 season (2021 15-yr extension)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.summary: Runs through the 2035-36 season, in a privately owned arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease to 2037 (15 years beyond the old term), with a five-year option to 2042 at the team's discretion (council report, b)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Up to $200M in liquidated damages if the team relocates before the term ends (council report, b)
rows.summary: Runs to 2037, with an option to 2042; leaving before 2037 costs up to $200M.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Up to $200M in liquidated damages if the team relocates before the term ends (council report, b)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Through June 30 2040 under the 2014 agreements (UPI; Commission Auditor notes, b); from 2025 either side may ask to renegotiate the terms for July 2035-June 2040 and, if either elects, terminate from July 1 2035
rows.outs_penalties_notes: County subsidy $6.4M/yr (FY26 budget) rising to $8.5M 2031-35
rows.summary: Runs through the 2039-40 season, but either side may end it from July 2035.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: County subsidy $6.4M/yr (FY26 budget) rising to $8.5M 2031-35

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: About 2041: the Lakers signed a 20-year lease extension with AEG about a year before Aug 2022 (Los Angeles Times via Yahoo, c); the exact end is not public
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.summary: AEG owns the arena on city land leased to 2053; the Lakers' lease with AEG was extended about 20 years in 2021, to about 2041.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 25-yr agreement 2019-2044 + 1-yr team option
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Pacers may terminate if CIB fails to appropriate ~$12.5M/yr reimbursements or capital; Pacers owe up to $750M if they fail to play home games; if the Pacers and the CIB do not agree on more technology funding by 2036, the Pacers could terminate (IBJ 2019, c)
rows.summary: Runs from 2019 to 2044; the team owes up to $750M if it fails to play its home games there.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Pacers may terminate if CIB fails to appropriate ~$12.5M/yr reimbursements or capital; Pacers owe up to $750M if they fail to play home games; if the Pacers and the CIB do not agree on more technology funding by 2036, the Pacers could terminate (IBJ 2019, c)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Extended from 2030 to 2045 (council vote of 10-1, June 13 2022)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: City was already obligated to spend $173M under the old lease; the Hornets pay a total of $32M in rent through 2045 (start year not stated) and continue a $1.1M-a-year capital fund contribution (WBTV); under the 2005 lease the rent was a capital amount of $250,000 rising to $500,000 (Marquette summary)
rows.summary: Extended in 2022 from 2030 to 2045.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: City was already obligated to spend $173M under the old lease; the Hornets pay a total of $32M in rent through 2045 (start year not stated) and continue a $1.1M-a-year capital fund contribution (WBTV); under the 2005 lease the rent was a capital amount of $250,000 rising to $500,000 (Marquette summary)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Non-relocation to 2046 (matches bond maturity)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Break-up fee up to $200M before 2046; Hawks pay $5.9M/yr lease after bonds retire 2028
rows.summary: Runs to 2046; leaving earlier costs up to $200M.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Break-up fee up to $200M before 2046; Hawks pay $5.9M/yr lease after bonds retire 2028

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 30-yr lease (signed Apr 2016) + two 5-yr TEAM options; team may negotiate with third parties in last 5 yrs of term
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Non-relocation damages of at least $553M in year 1, declining; the floor is reported as $20M (BizTimes) or $200M (WPR, quoting the district chair)
rows.summary: Runs 30 years from 2016, with two five-year team options; leaving costs at least $553M in the first year, declining.
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Non-relocation damages of at least $553M in year 1, declining; the floor is reported as $20M (BizTimes) or $200M (WPR, quoting the district chair)

rows.owner: District of Columbia (since the 2024 purchase); Monumental leases it back
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease-back to DCALP through June 30, 2050, with up to five 4-yr renewals; Wizards and Capitals must play home games there; no-shop to 2045
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Damages not quantified in the fiscal impact statement
rows.summary: Leased back through June 30, 2050; the teams must play their home games there.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Damages not quantified in the fiscal impact statement

rows.owner: City of Sacramento (public title; "sold" to Kings for accounting)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 35-yr non-relocation + two 5-yr extensions (term sheet); ~2051 inferred
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Kings minimum lease payments $406.2M over 35 yrs
rows.summary: A 35-year commitment from 2016, with two five-year extensions.
rows.label: c/u + b
rows.exit_penalty: Kings minimum lease payments $406.2M over 35 yrs

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Through at least 2053: 25 years from move-in to the new arena (KGOU 2025-06-18; Bond Buyer 2026-04-06); earlier reports said at least 2050
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Early-exit penalties of up to $1B, declining over the term: $1B if the team leaves in the first five years after moving into the new arena, $850M in years 6-10, and a scale that continues for the 25 years (city release, June 17 2025); KGOU: "up to $1 billion"
rows.summary: Runs through at least 2053, with penalties of up to $1B for leaving early, declining over the term.
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Early-exit penalties of up to $1B, declining over the term: $1B if the team leaves in the first five years after moving into the new arena, $850M in years 6-10, and a scale that continues for the 25 years (city release, June 17 2025); KGOU: "up to $1 billion"

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Arena license to June 30, 2055, fees +3%/yr
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: A company under the same family control owns the arena; the Knicks use it under a license to 2055, and the tax exemption depends on hosting the Knicks and Rangers.
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.owner: Smith Entertainment Group (private) + SLC participation agreement
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 30-yr non-relocation tied to SLC 0.5% sales tax from 2025 (~2054-55 inferred)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: If both teams leave, Smith Entertainment Group must repay the outstanding sales-tax bonds whose proceeds it received; if one team leaves, 50% of a $250M liquidated damages amount in years 1-15, reduced by $16,666,667 a year to zero at year 30, so $125M at most (draft participation agreement of July 5 2024, s.11.8(d), b; the executed agreement of Dec 10 2024 was not read)
rows.summary: The teams commit to stay 30 years; if both leave, the owner repays the arena bonds it received, and if one leaves, damages of up to $125M.
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: If both teams leave, Smith Entertainment Group must repay the outstanding sales-tax bonds whose proceeds it received; if one team leaves, 50% of a $250M liquidated damages amount in years 1-15, reduced by $16,666,667 a year to zero at year 30, so $125M at most (draft participation agreement of July 5 2024, s.11.8(d), b; the executed agreement of Dec 10 2024 was not read)

rows.owner: Brooklyn Arena LDC (public LDC; BSE operates)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Non-relocation agreement cited by Moody's as PILOT-bond credit positive; PILOT bonds final debt service 2046
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Term/penalty not confirmed
rows.summary: Bound by a non-relocation agreement; its term was not confirmed.
rows.label: c/u
rows.exit_penalty: Term/penalty not confirmed

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner; no public lease
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: No public lease; the owners' joint venture owns the arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner; with the Oct 21 2024 rezoning and development agreement, the Nuggets and Avalanche agreed to remain in the area until June 30 2050 (c); penalty not found
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: No public lease; under a 2024 development agreement the Nuggets and Avalanche stay in the area until June 30, 2050.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Pistons MOU with DDA (2016); 35-yr term widely reported but not verified (MOU PDF 403)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: $36M 2017 DDA bonds to make arena NBA-compliant
rows.summary: Set by a 2016 agreement with the city's development authority; a 35-year term is reported but not verified.
rows.label: b/u
rows.exit_penalty: $36M 2017 DDA bonds to make arena NBA-compliant

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-owned
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: No public lease; the team owns the arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-owned
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: No public lease; the team owns the arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.summary: No public lease; the owner owns the arena.
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

method: select l.team, l.arena, l.owner, l.term_end_year, l.term_and_nonrelocation, l.outs_penalties_notes, l.summary, l.label, a.exit_penalty, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'renovation' and i.status = 'pending') as pending_2026_m, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'project' and i.status <> 'pending' and i.item_id <> 'UTA-project') as new_arena_2026_m, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'project' and i.status = 'pending') as new_arena_pending_2026_m, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.ord) from lease_sources s where s.team = l.team), []) as sources from leases l left join arenas a using (team) order by l.term_end_year nulls last, l.team
